skills/tree.description: Universal radial-tree exploration engine — loads a preset, grounds a root, expands every node through 12 framing passes, derives each child in 12 evidence-bearing fields, scores it, and recurses on `advances` leaves until substantive convergence (or a user cap). Caps default to ∞; `defer / TODO / NEEDS-MORE-INFO` leaves are hard-banned.
